name: forest-winter
description: A winter night behind your chats: snowy pines, snow that piles up as the context fills, a moon in its real phase, a campfire that burns while Claude works.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: "drawing": everything is a vector drawing, very light. "shader": adds a flowing aurora and snow on the message box, computed on the GPU (uses more power and can soften the picture).
